scripts.text: SELECT MAX(MEMBER_SOURCE_UPDATE_DT) FROM PDS_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_SOURCE_CD = 'FAC'

source.sqlReaderQuery: DECLARE @NEXT_CALLLIST_DATE DATETIME  SET @NEXT_CALLLIST_DATE = CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(DAY,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,GETDATE())>=17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,GETDATE()))  SELECT   MEME.MEME_CK						MEMBER_MEMBER_ID   ,SBSB.SBSB_ID + '00'				MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER   ,'FAC'							MEMBER_SOURCE_CD   ,MEME.MEME_MEDCD_NO				MEMBER_MCAID_NUMBER   ,NULL								MEMBER_MCAID_STATE   ,MEME.MEME_HICN					MEMBER_MCARE_NUMBER   ,MEME.MEME_SSN					MEMBER_SOC_SECURITY   ,MEME.MEME_ID_NAME                MEMBER_CALLED_NAME   ,MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME             MEMBER_FIRST_NAME   ,MEME.MEME_MID_INIT               MEMBER_MIDDLE_NAME   ,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME              MEMBER_LAST_NAME   ,MEME.MEME_SEX					MEMBER_GENDER_CD   ,MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT               MEMBER_BIRTH_DT   ,NULL								MEMBER_RECERTIFICATIONDATE   ,MEME.MEME_ORIG_EFF_DT            MEMBER_RECERTIFICATION_DT   ,NULL								MEMBER_DUALELIGIBLE_IND   ,NULL								MEMBER_DUALELIGIBLE_MEMBER_IID   ,MEME.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM			MEMBER_SOURCE_CREATE_DT   ,COALESCE(MEME.SYS_USUS_ID,'dbo')					MEMBER_SOURCE_CREATE_USER   ,MEME.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM           MEMBER_SOURCE_UPDATE_DT   ,COALESCE(MEME.SYS_USUS_ID,'dbo')					MEMBER_SOURCE_UPDATE_USER   ,MECD.MECD_AUTO_ASSN_IND			MEMBER_MEDICAID_AUTO_IND   ,COALESCE(ADDR_TYPE_HOME.IR_CODESET_CD,'UNK')		MEMBER_ADDRESS_HOME_TYPE   ,COALESCE(ADDR_TYPE_MAIL.IR_CODESET_CD,'UNK') MEMBER_ADDRESS_MAIL_TYPE  ,MEME.MEME_MCTR_LANG				MEMBER_LANGUAGE_CD ,MEME.MEME_CK				MEMBER_MEME_CK ,MEME.GRGR_CK				MEMBER_GRGR_CK FROM   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 		AND MEME.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM > ? 	LEFT OUTER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MECD_MEDICAID MECD ON MECD.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 		AND @NEXT_CALLLIST_DATE BETWEEN MECD.MECD_EFF_DT AND MECD.MECD_TERM_DT 	LEFT OUTER JOIN ODW.DW.IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE ADDR_TYPE_HOME ON ADDR_TYPE_HOME.SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC'  			AND ADDR_TYPE_HOME.CODESET_CD = 'AD' 			AND ADDR_TYPE_HOME.SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD = MEME.SBAD_TYPE_HOME 	LEFT OUTER JOIN ODW.DW.IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE ADDR_TYPE_MAIL ON ADDR_TYPE_MAIL.SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC'  			AND ADDR_TYPE_MAIL.CODESET_CD = 'AD' 			AND ADDR_TYPE_MAIL.SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD = MEME.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL 	LEFT OUTER JOIN ##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers T ON T.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID 		AND SBSB.SBSB_CK <> T.SBSB_CK WHERE   T.SBSB_ID IS NULL

UPDATE MLS
SET MEMBER_LANGUAGE_STAGING_LANGUAGE = L.LANGUAGE_DESCRIPTION
FROM PDS_MEMBER_LANGUAGE_STAGING MLS
	INNER JOIN PDS_LANGUAGE L ON L.LANGUAGE_CD = MLS.MEMBER_LANGUAGE_STAGING_LANGUAGE_CD
